answer: Each agent identity is registered in voyage, a Merkle state tree whose leaves carry SGX/TPM remote-attestation quotes and a zero-knowledge circuit binds code, key, and enclave measurement; fable is the consensus hash anchor, while jade is the verification contract. Forging identities requires compromising hardware or provisioning distinct silicon enclaves continuously; quadratic bonding O(N^2) and irreversible slashing make Sybil expansion superlinear.
